widgets.name: Clock
widgets.description: Plain digits, or a split-flap display whose digits flip when the minute changes. With the date, if you want it.

sizes.note: Four cells wide and two tall.
sizes.alt: The clock widget in its split-flap style, showing the time and the date.

widgets.name: Stats
widgets.description: Any reading as a number or a gauge: CPU, memory and GPU load, temperature, power and clock.

sizes.note: Four gauges above three text readings.
sizes.alt: The stats widget at 4x4: four gauges for CPU load, GPU temperature, GPU load and memory, above three text readings.

sizes.note: Two readings on top, three text readings below.
sizes.alt: The stats widget at 4x2: a bar for CPU load and a memory gauge above three text readings.

widgets.name: Weather
widgets.description: Animated icons and the forecast for any number of places, from Open-Meteo.

sizes.note: Current conditions with the forecast for the days ahead.
sizes.alt: The weather widget at 4x4: current conditions and a five-day forecast.

sizes.note: Current conditions on a shorter card.
sizes.alt: The weather widget at 4x2: current conditions.

widgets.name: Shortcut
widgets.description: The icon of an application, a folder or a web address. Tap it and it opens. A dock keeps up to four of them in the same place on every page.

sizes.note: One cell each, on a page or in the dock.
sizes.alt: The dock with four shortcuts: GitHub, Wikipedia, Steam and VS Code.
